mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, topic, content, likes_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{topic}, #{content}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM posts WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, topic, content, likes_count, created_at, updated_at FROM posts WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
